caption: Network Scan Finding
description: A Network Scan Finding reports the lifecycle of a network scan finding. Each finding carries scan probe results and scan job metadata, and supports Create, Update, and Close activities for finding lifecycle tracking.
name: network_scan_finding

1.caption: Create
1.description: A new network scan finding was created based on initial scan results.

2.caption: Update
2.description: An existing network scan finding was updated with new scan results.

3.caption: Close
3.description: A network scan finding was closed because the condition is no longer detected.

network_scan_info.description: The metadata about the network scan job that produced this finding, including scan timestamps, completion status, scanner endpoints, and operational flags.

port_scan_result_list.description: The per-port scan probe results for the target host, each containing port details, probe status, and identified service. For Close activities, producers must populate this field with the last-known scan results that triggered the finding.

resources.caption: Scanned Resources
resources.description: The resources that were the target of the network scan, such as EC2 instances, Elastic IPs, or load balancers.
